description: This file defines a WebSocket connection manager class for a real-time sports live streaming backend, managing active connections, handling connection events, and broadcasting updates such as emoji reactions and match data to connected clients.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: A class that manages WebSocket connections, handling connect/disconnect events, message broadcasting, and per-user messaging for real-time updates.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the connection manager with dictionaries to track active connections, user connections, and connection metadata.

methods.name: connect(self, websocket: WebSocket, event_id: str, user_id: str = None)
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket connection, associates it with an event and optionally a user, and sends a welcome message.

methods.name: disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket connection from all tracking dictionaries.

methods.name: send_personal_message(self, message: Dict[str, Any], websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to a specific WebSocket.

methods.name: broadcast_to_event(self, message: Dict[str, Any], event_id: str)
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all WebSocket connections associated with a specific event.

methods.name: broadcast_emoji_reaction(self, event_id: str, emoji_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts an emoji reaction update to all connections of a specific event.

methods.name: broadcast_match_update(self, event_id: str, match_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts match data updates to all connections of a specific event.

methods.name: send_to_user(self, user_id: str, message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Sends a message directly to a specific user identified by user_id.

methods.name: int get_connection_count(self, event_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the number of active connections for a given event.

methods.name: int get_total_connections(self)
methods.description: Returns the total number of active WebSocket connections.

methods.name: List[str] get_active_events(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of event IDs with active connections.
